BETA Close X Ninety One plc has announced the repurchase of 219,805 ordinary shares between September 1 and September 4, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share was approximately 209.17 GBp. Since June 3, 2026, the company has bought back a total of 7,325,143 shares for £15,699,316.39. Following these transactions, Ninety One plc holds no shares in treasury, and its total number of ordinary shares in issue is now 661,347,257.
